_description: Battle simulator v1 (tools/nn/sim, docs/en/training/simulator.md): the numbers that are neither in a unit passport (config/nn/units.json) nor in the game's rules (config/nn/game_rules.json). Each is measured in the game or calibrated to a measurement (docs/en/training/measurements.md); `why` says which. Written by hand; python -m tools.nn.sim.check compares the simulator with the game.

step_s.why: morale rises 2 points a second before contact in every recording (+0.057 MoralePercent/s at leadership 35 ... +0.029 at 70) = one point (minimium_increment_update_per_tick) per 0.5 s tick

battle_limit_s.why: network plan: 60 minutes, the attacker loses on time

map_half_m.why: measured: routing units leave the map at |x| or |z| = 1020 m (Crossroads flat, 28 runs)

formation.why: arena spearmen: 120 men, width 30 m, rank_depth 6 -> 20 files 1.5 m apart; ranks the same. Centre distance at first contact in the pairs (7.5-12.8 m) matches the depths this gives

turn.why: formation_deg_s / single_deg_s: out of melee a standing unit (not walking) turns in place at most this fast (a lord or another single entity: single_deg_s); a walking unit faces the way it walks, in melee contact.melee_turn_deg_s holds. Measured 04.10.2026 (build/p3, all 210 arena runs with 1 s samples since 30.09): missile units standing out of melee whose engine target becomes an enemy 60 deg or more off their bearing faced it within 20 deg after 1 s (median; mean 1.6 s for 60-120 deg, 1.7 s for 120-180 deg; 97 % of 160 within 15 s), (angle - 20) / seconds p25 45 / p50 64 / p75 117 deg/s - a lower bound, a turn done within the second counts a whole second; turning episodes of standing units (mv off, < 0.3 m/s, out of melee, >= 60 deg): missile infantry p50 81 deg/s (858), melee infantry 72 (23: they rarely stand and turn), lords 40 (p25 31, p75 66; 440 episodes, 2 s for 60-100 deg). 80 for formations, 40 for single entities. Before: the bearing was set at once, so a standing shooter facing away shot at once.

contact.pin_why: pin_s: a missile unit leaving melee (leave_m) stays held this long in contact (not striking, struck), then walks out; a melee unit and a lone man are not held. Measured 04.10.2026 (sim task 2, build/p2/miss.py): the network's missile units in melee given a move or withdraw to a point 15 m or more away, all 93 network runs with companion logs from 02.10.2026 (254 episodes): share still in melee (Kaplan-Meier, an order change censors) 0.95 / 0.82 / 0.57 / 0.34 / 0.25 at 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 s, out after 6-7 s (median), escape 0.065-0.077 a second, still in melee 3 s later 0.85 (gate 20261004-071805: 0.93); the simulator (both sides replayed on that gate's 8 battles) walked them out in about 2 s (0.53 at 2 s, 0.24 a second, 3 s later 0.38). At 5 s: 0.076 a second, out after 6 s, 3 s later 0.88. Melee units already stay as in the game without it (their enemies follow them: 0.83 / 0.76 at 4 / 5 s against the game's 0.83 / 0.80, 0.048 against 0.041 a second); held too, 0.94 were still in melee 3 s later (game 0.81).
contact.why: reach: pairs touch when the formations' edges meet (centre distance 10.6-12.8 m for spearmen against slaves, depths 9 and 13.5 m). lord_max_attackers / lord_direction / lord_rival_others / lord_incidental: the lord swarm probe (01.10.2026, docs/en/game/units/lord-swarm.md; 3 battles, a lord standing, attacked by 1-4 infantry units from front, back and flanks, 5 repeats a layout, lords held by script so no abilities): the lord loses the same whatever the number of units (General 7.8 / 8.3 / 8.7 / 7.4 HP/s with 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 clanrat units, Warlord 6.2 / 5.8 / 5.1 / 4.8 with Empire spearmen); 4-5 enemy soldiers stand within 2.5 m of him, 7-10 within 3 m, shared by the units; an armour-piercing unit counts by its share (General: halberds alone 21.5, with one spear unit 16.1, with three 10.7). So the men striking a lord are capped in all (9 fits the probe's single units and the pairs) and summed, split between the units by their contact; from his back or flank they hit him as from the front (lord_direction 0: the share of the database's flank/rear rule against a lone man). lord_rival_others: with the enemy lord on him too, the infantry's rate counts at this share (whole battles, a lord in melee not shot at: the enemy lord alone 14.5 HP/s, with 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 units targeting him too 18.6 / 10.6 / 15.1 / 20.4; the probe's lord-and-units trials, noisy: 0.7 +- 0.5). lord_incidental: a unit whose attack order is on another enemy strikes a lord it only touches at this share (whole battles: one enemy unit in contact, its current target another: 1.7 HP/s; him: 4.1). Front = within 60 deg of the facing (shield_defence_angle_melee 60), rear = beyond 120 deg. melee_turn_deg_s: a formation in melee turns no faster (a lord at once): measured in the 28 whole battles, infantry in melee standing turns 1 deg/s (median, mean 2.3; 20.8k seconds), a free unit struck in the flank turns 8 deg in the next 5 s (median, 653 contacts). step_m: a unit whose point is nearer does not turn to walk there (formations step back or aside facing the enemy); without it, units replayed to their recorded points stood with their backs to the enemy at contact in the pairs; leave_m: any unit in melee told to move this far or farther leaves the fight like a withdraw (0: off): it strikes nobody and is not held in place, the enemies in contact still strike it. Melee units (03.10.2026, build/gap/leave.py, melee_orders.py; the sim-to-game gap of the gate build/nn-gate/20261003-030449): our non-missile non-lord units in melee by the order in force, all 99 fair network runs with companion logs: attack 0.186 kills/s and 0.0026 HP share lost/s (129.8k unit-s), hold 0.225 / 0.0038, move to a point 10 m or more away 0.012 / 0.0045 (3.9k unit-s, moving 99 % of the time), withdraw 0.004 / 0.0038; in the gate itself attack 0.415 / 0.0035, move 0.007 / 0.0050 (34 % of our melee unit-seconds). So a melee unit moving away deals ~6 % of its attack rate and takes ~1.7x the damage; it stays in contact 97.5 % of the next seconds. The simulator kept it fighting at full rate (a move in melee was a free no-op, which the network learned to use: 45 % of its non-missile melee seconds in that gate against 0-2 % in earlier gates). The replay (tools/nn/sim/replay.py) moves such a unit to its recorded point only where that point is a move order in force: the network's units and missile units; CA's planner's and the game's AI's melee units with a far recorded point fight on in the game (the planner's: 0.17-0.29 kills/s in every direction, its point often the enemy's start beyond the enemy; build/simbatch/leave_dir.py), and leaving them made the spearmen-clanrats pair wrong. With it: the check's same winner, the network's battles 44 -> 47 of 93 (the 8 gate battles of build/nn-gate/20261003-030449: 4 -> 7 of 8; at 4 replays 4 + 1 split -> 7), the game-AI battles 22 of 26 both, mechanics 50 -> 51 of 54. Missile units, measured 02.10.2026 (build/simacc/missile_break.py, 28 game-AI and 63 network battles): the game's missile units in melee without a target and with their order point 10 m or more away were moving 45-78 % of those seconds and left melee after 10-12 s (median), against 19-36 s and 2-18 % moving for those holding near their point; the simulator keeps missile units in melee 284 s a battle against the game's 162 (median spell 15 s against 8). At 10 m (and the replay moving such units instead of fighting the nearest enemy) the check got no better (same winner 19 of 26 and 37 of 63 with the two lord numbers below; 20 / 36 without it), so it stays off. Task 20 (02.10.2026): on at 10 m together with lord_v_lord 0.73, lord_fall 0 and the database set (sim.json morale why): each alone lowered the winners because the errors compensated each other; together with the rest the winners hold (game-AI 18 of 26, network 43 of 71 against 20 / 43 with all off) and more battles end as in the game. lord_v_lord: a lord striking a lord hits at this share of the rule (1: off). Measured 02.10.2026 (build/simacc/lordduel.py): HP/s of a lord in melee whose only enemy on him is the other lord, not shot at, in the 28 game-AI and 63 network battles: the General 14.6 (2.5k s), the Warlord 10.0 (1.6k s) in the game, 19.4 / 15.0 in the simulator: 0.73. Infantry on a lord is too strong in those battles as well (one unit on him: game 3.3 / 2.9, simulator 4.7 / 4.1) while the lord swarm probe and the pairs match. At 0.73 the network battles got worse (same winner 36 of 63 against 40; mean |side-balance error| 0.176 against 0.165): something else compensates, so it stays off until the battle-level lord loss is understood. On since task 20 (see leave_m; for every unit since 03.10.2026). Still: the simulator's lords fall too soon in whole battles (network battles: median 130-145 s earlier than the game; at 4 % health against the game's 16 %; in melee 53 % of their time against 45 %) - the game's lords break off melee (0.030 a second) and shatter with health left, which the simulator does not have unit_incidental: a unit attacking another enemy strikes an incidental enemy unit at this share. Use 1.0 after contact-phase replay synchronisation (build/gap5/replay_task; 4 copies, seed 1, 2 m jitter, both sides replayed). Gates 20261004-230630 / 20261004-071805 / 20261003-204730: game trade -0.306 / -0.260 / -0.407; at game end, phases with 0.3: -0.036 / +0.054 / -0.156, 0.6: -0.057 / -0.034 / -0.209, 1.0: -0.090 / -0.080 / -0.252; at sim end, 1.0: -0.152 / -0.086 / -0.280. Mean absolute trade error at game/sim end: 0.3 0.278/0.269, 0.6 0.225/0.202, 1.0 0.184/0.151. Matched check (CUDA battles, CPU mechanics, original 132 decided network battles, 8 copies): old replay 22/26 AI and 81/132 network; phases 0.3 22/26 and 78/132, 0.6 22/26 and 91/132, 1.0 23/26 and 98/132; mechanics 51/54 throughout. The old 0.3 fit used clock-indexed replays (game 19.6 HP/s, sim 33.9 at 1 and 22.3 at 0.3) and may have compensated for their contact errors. Contact starts/melee-second now 0.0300 (game 0.0300), but running entries 85.1% against 97.8%: fidelity is still incomplete. hold_rate: a unit without a missile weapon under HOLD in melee (no attack order) strikes at this share of its rate (calibrated, 04.10.2026, sim-to-game gap 3, P4; build/gap3/p4/kills.py, holdatk2.py, kills_cmp.py). The game, all fair network runs with companion logs (the network's own orders), our melee units in melee, not moving, health >= 0.3, matched on own and nearest enemy unit keys: under HOLD they kill 0.80 of what the same units kill attacking (the game's own kill count, 14.8k matched unit-s) and an enemy unit fighting them alone loses 0.66-0.74 of the HP; held units with an engine target (18 % of held melee seconds) fight like attacking ones, without one 0.56-0.70: the game fights only a held unit's men in contact. Missile units 0.99-1.01: not for them. The simulator gives a held unit its full rate on every side in contact (an attacking one only 0.3 on enemies other than its target), so with the measured 0.75 the held units of the gate battles (20261004-071805 + seed 1000900014, 2.3 enemy units in melee within 40 m, as in the game) still killed 0.26 a second in the replay and 0.27 against ai_like against the game's 0.17; at 0.5: 0.18 / 0.18 (attacking units: game 0.24, against ai_like 0.23). Before (full rate) the network learned to hold in melee: n3 held 76 % of its melee seconds in the simulator, killing 0.33 a second there; n3 against ai_like on those 8 battles +0.19 (game -0.27), at 0.75 +0.07, at 0.5 -0.08 (same winner 2 / 4 / 7 of 8); both sides replayed -0.100 / -0.065 / -0.089 (same winner 6 / 5 / 7).

melee.why: splash_divides: a splash blow's damage is divided among the men it strikes (CA forum, the community; docs/en/game/mechanics/melee.md#splash), then each share is capped at a man's health: no change for the lords against today's infantry (a share is still above a man's 48-76 HP), it matters for heavier targets. The rest: calibrated on the four melee pairs (tools/nn/sim/check.py). The hit_slope 0.1 is kept against the database's 1 (CA confirmed the formula, task 20): the pairs show the same losses whatever attack - defence is, so something else (matched combat, blow cycle) flattens it in practice. The database rule hit = 35 + attack - defence does not fit: the losses of all four pairs and both lords need about the same 30-38 % whatever attack - defence is (from -35 to +31); hit_slope scales attack - defence (1 = the database rule). fighting_files: men striking = this share of the files in contact (0.75 x 20 = 15 of a 30 m front). impact: extra damage of a charging unit in the first 13 s (charge_decay_duration), times the charge factor; fitted to the HP lost in the first 15 s of the pairs, then lowered from 2.5 to 1.5 on the 28 whole battles (01.10.2026): there a unit charged while standing lost 0.82 of what its charger lost in the first 15 s (102 contacts), the simulator at 2.5 gave 2.7; at 1.5 the pairs stay 51 of 54 within 20 %. flank_slope / rear_slope: defence lost to a flank / rear attack counts at this weight of the rule (1 = the database rule; a lone man always 1): fitted so that infantry fought on the flank loses 1.74x (1.56-1.89 over runs) and on the rear 1.31x (1.19-1.42) what it loses from the front in the whole battles (5.5k / 2.1k seconds; sector by the angle of the enemy's centre, as the simulator counts it); the simulator gives 1.55 / 1.50. braced_speed: a unit with charge_reflection slower than this (m/s) at contact is braced and meets a frontal infantry charge as a charge (measured: braced spearmen charged head-on lose 0.80 of what the charger loses, 87 contacts; the database's charge_reflect_min_charge_factor_threshold 0.7 is not applied, chargers here meet their target at 0.55-0.9 of their run)

kills.why: men lost per HP lost: blows that do not kill wound; men share = max(1 - g (1 - hp share), hp share), g = (hits to kill)^-exponent; fitted to men against health in the pairs (at half health: slaves 0.6 of men, spearmen 0.7-0.78; lords kill whole men: 1)

missile.reload_ref_why: reload_s was measured on the archers (passport 10 s) and the skavenslave slingers (9 s); another unit of the category gets reload_s x its passport reload / this (the Night Runners' sling, passport 8 s: 10.2 s). Not measured for them.
missile.musket_why: ESTIMATE, not measured (02.10.2026): Free Company Militia pistols (category musket, trajectory low = direct fire, range 90 m, passport reload 9 s -> 10.8 s by reload_scale_other, aim_s_other). The projectile's calibration area is 2.0 m at 65 m against the arrow's 3.7 m at 95 m: at the edge of range the pistol spreads 2.0 x 90 / 65 = 2.8 m, the arrow 3.7 x 125 / 95 = 4.9 m; a flat shot also carries on through the ranks (penetration low: up to 2 men). 0.5 x the distance factor at 60-90 m (1.12-1.29) gives 0.56-0.65 hits per shot, between the arrow's 0.42 and 1 / spread scaling (0.74). To measure: docs/en/training/units.md, recordings wanted.
missile.stand_fire_why: stand_fire_arc_deg 45: standing, a unit shoots only at targets within this angle of its facing; one beyond it is turned to first (turn.formation_deg_s) and aimed at (aim_s) only once within it; without an ordered target the nearest within the arc is taken, else the unit turns to the nearest beyond it. Measured 04.10.2026 (build/p3, 210 arena runs): the volleys of standing missile units out of melee (84.5k, ammo a man dropping >= 0.03 in a second) are within 15 deg of the direction to the engine's target (else the nearest enemy) 70.6 %, 15-30 deg 23.7 %, 30-45 deg 4.8 %, 45-60 deg 0.7 %, beyond 60 deg 0.3 % (p95 31, p99 45; each unit type p99 31-47, militia 121 from its moving fire). A new engine target while standing, no volley in the 3 s before: the first volley 2 s later (median) at 0-40 deg off, 3 s at 60-180 deg (the turn about 1 s). 180: off.
missile.volley_why: volley_load 1: the unit shoots once all its men are loaded, so whole-unit volleys one reload apart (the archer range: ~80 of 90 arrows within 1 s of the first, then ~10 s nothing; the shooting arenas: volleys one reload apart). 0 was every loaded man at once: a volley, then at once a steady trickle. Measured 04.10.2026 (sim task 2, build/p2/halt.py, reload.py): shooters that halt in battle and stand 12 s or more out of melee with an enemy in range shoot in those 12 s 0.55 projectiles a man (the network's) / 0.72-0.76 (the game AI's), the first shot 4-6 s after the halt (1 s samples; the range gives 2-3 s on the same count), units never shot before 0.82-0.94; the simulator 1.5-1.7 (the volley, then the trickle at once), with 1: 1.0. The men keep reloading on the move: units that shot less than 4 s before moving off shoot after the halt as much as those loaded long before. aim_reset_on_order 1: a new order (another kind or another attack target) makes a shooter aim again (aim_s): in the game a unit that shot in the 3 s before, standing with an enemy in range, given an attack order shoots in 0.35 / 0.26 of its next 10 s (arrows / slings) against 0.47 / 0.42 given no order in 10 s, its first shot 2 / 5 s later against at once; given hold 0.21 / 0.19, 5-7 s (all network runs from 02.10.2026, 23k unit-seconds); the network's halts had a new order between the halt and the first shot 0.92-0.97 of the time. move_fire_arc_deg 90: firing whilst moving (Free Company Militia) only at targets within this angle of the facing (the way it walks): our militia moving 0.5 m/s or more, in range, out of melee shoots 0.52 of its full rate toward the nearest enemy (within 60 deg), 0.31 across, 0.16 away (1.4k s); the simulator 0.57 / 0.75 / 0.83, at 90 deg 0.50 / 0.54 / 0.13. The game AI's militia does not shoot on the move at all (0.00-0.02 of its 1.4k moving seconds in range): its control, not the attribute.
missile.why: measured (measurements.md, shooting at a unit that stands): reload in practice 11.0 s arrows (passport 10) and 11.5 s sling (passport 9); hit rate at the edge of range 0.42 and 0.47; first shot 3.3 and 4.3 s after halting. Other projectiles: the mean, reload x1.2 of the passport. distance_factor: HP per arrow against the distance, relative to 105-130 m, from the range test (28.09.2026, standing spearmen: c = 13.4 at 70 m, 11.6 at 90 m, 9.5-10.4 at 105-120 m), held below 70 m; the arena's 34 m (~25 HP) and 52 m (~18 HP) are left out: they exceed or reach the arrow's whole damage (19), so melee losses are mixed in. single_entity_factor: HP a lord loses per projectile aimed at him while he is out of melee for the whole flight (the shot's second and the 2 s after), against the unit rule with his armour, shield (by the shooter's side), resistance and distance factor: 0.43 over ~33k shots of the 18 mirror and 10 Empire-Skaven battles (General by arrows ~0.5, by sling ~0.37, Warlord by arrows ~0.32; per battle median 0.43). An earlier count gave 0.9: its 2-second loss windows overlapped and counted each loss twice. friendly_fire: of the hits aimed at a unit in melee, the share that lands on the shooter's own units in contact with it. Measured in the recordings: in the seconds a missile unit shoots an enemy that fights its own units (and nobody shoots those units), their HP lost beyond the melee rule (and beyond the 1.15x / 1.5x they lose when their own side does not shoot), against those shots' hits by the unit rule: arrows 0.26 (18 mirror battles, 1.5k seconds), sling 0.56 (10 Empire-Skaven battles, 1.3k seconds); other projectiles: the mean; a lord among those units takes his share x single_entity_factor (a lone target; 01.10.2026, otherwise a lord in melee with shot enemies took the whole friendly fire). spill: of the hits aimed at a unit, the share that lands on each other unit of the target's side out of melee, by the distance between their centres: in the recordings a unit nobody shoots at, out of melee, with an enemy-shot neighbour within 30 m loses 0.115 of the hits that neighbour takes by the unit rule (2.1k seconds), 0.034 at 30-60 m (6.3k), 0.015 at 60-90 m (7.2k), 0.005 beyond (units with no shot neighbour lose 0.7 HP/s); spill_melee: the same for the target's own units that are in melee too, when the target is in melee (01.10.2026, build/nn-sim/flank/spill_melee.py: HP a unit in melee, not shot at itself and whose own side does not shoot its opponents, loses regressed on its melee rule and on the hits aimed at other units of its side in melee, by centre distance: 0.19 within 15 m, 0.047 at 15-30 m, 0.035 at 30-60 m (the 27 net runs and the 28 game-AI battles, 74k seconds, 15k with a shot neighbour; the 28 battles alone 0.23 / 0.09 / 0.16, the net runs 0.19 / 0.05 / 0.035, the far bin taken from the net runs). Before it, only units out of melee took spill, so units fighting around a lord the enemy shoots at (run 20261001-074420) lost nothing to those shots; it is why an infantry unit in a whole battle loses ~1.3x per shot aimed at it what the lone target of the shooting arena does. Without it a unit in melee loses 3.2x the melee rule (Skaven infantry) and 2.2x (Empire infantry, mirror) while its own missile units shoot at the enemy it fights, 1.5x and 1.15x otherwise

morale.why: Task 20 (02.10.2026, build/simacc/kb_eval.py, kb_events.py, collapse.py; docs/en/game/mechanics/README.md conflicts): casualties_s: the window of recent casualties (the database's description, WH2: the last 4 s; extended casualties -4...-60 over the last 60 s, extended_s). Taken literally (4 s + 60 s) the archers' target wavers 90 % late (73 s against 39 s) and the slingers' target never wavers; 10 s: +54 %; 30 s with the 60 s extended casualties on top: the pairs waver too early (47 of 54). Only the single 30 s window keeps 51 of 54, so it stays (extended_s 0: off) - the game's recent casualties are probably counted otherwise (to record: CCO PercentCasualtiesRecently / PercentHpLostRecently). attacked_event: the database's was_attacked_in_flank / _rear -6 / -14 for the 0.5 s tick a unit is first struck from a worse side (battle.py), instead of the regressed -1 / -2 while struck: in the 91 recordings a unit first struck in the flank drops 1.5 points more over 1-2 s than one first struck in front (309 / 1457 contacts), in the rear 1.9 more (202) - one tick of -6 / -14 (1 and 2.1 points); a new attacker on a unit already fighting: 0.4-0.9 more. aura_fade: the lord's +4 fades from 70 m to 0 at 105 m (inspiration_radius_max_effect_range_modifier 1.5). collapse: the database's army destruction (ume_concerned_army_destruction -120 when the enemy's strength >= army_destruction_enemy_strength_ratio 2.6 x own and own <= army_destruction_alliance_strength_ratio 0.22 of the start); strength = multiplayer cost x health share (hp_power) of the units counted: alive = not shattered, routing included (the game's 91 battles: the trigger fires at a collapse in 32 of 36 sides, median 2 s before it, but 36 collapses have no trigger), standing (79 triggers, 63 with a collapse, but 50 s early). The game's balance of power is not recorded yet (to record: CCO BattleRoot BalanceOfPowerPercent, unit:strategic_value()). Not modelled, checked: charge morale (the database's charge_bonus +15 / charge_timeout 60): a unit that runs into contact (3343 contacts) loses as much morale over the next 1-4 s as one met standing (1500), no +15 shows. lord_fall: points the rest of the army loses when its lord falls (dead or shattered), for recent_s, then lasting (on top of losing his aura). 0 / 0 since task 20 (the database's ume_concerned_general_died_recently -16 / _dead -10 before; the measurement below shows only the aura). Measured 02.10.2026 (build/simacc/lordfall2.py): in all 75 recorded lord falls the lord shattered with 2-50 % of his health left (none was killed), and the standing units of his army (167 unit-falls, 35 falls) changed by 0 points in the 10 s before, -1 at the fall, -3.2 / -4.3 / -4.7 / -4.8 (mean; median -3) 2 / 4 / 6 / 10 s after, -7 at 20 s - about the aura; the simulator gives -9 / -14 / -17 / -18 and routs 39 % of the army within 10 s of a fall (the game 21 %). With 0 / 0 the winners did not change (20 of 26, 36 of 63 with lord_v_lord) but more simulated battles stayed undecided at the recording's end (76 % against 66 %): the game's armies do collapse at the end, all at once (68 of 182 sides: 60 % of the standing units drop 0.4 MoralePercent within 3 s), by a rule not tied to the lord (the database's army destruction -120 at enemy / own strength 2.6 and own 22 % of the start does not time these collapses with strength = cost x health: 8-11 of 58 within 5 s). Until that rule is modelled the -16 / -10 stand in for it. faction_bonus: before contact Skaven units stand 6 points higher than the Empire's in the same place (slaves, clanrats, slingers; pairs, shooting, whole battles): that is Strength in Numbers' +6 (stat_morale, while health is above 50 % of the start), an innate effect since 02.10.2026 (config/nn/effects.json), so the bonus is 0 for every faction now (the Warlord, who lacks Strength in Numbers, lost the +6; it was never measured on him). recent_s / recent_of_current: the window of 'recent casualties' (the database gives the penalties, not the window) and whether its share is of the health left; calibrated on the waver and rout times of the pairs and the shooting. combat_ratio: melee HP dealt / taken for winning slightly, winning, significantly (the database gives only the points). rally_mp: a routing unit rallies at MoralePercent ~0.23 (morale.md, median 0.22 at 365 rallies). rally_free_m: no standing enemy that near (at 365 rallies of the mirror and Empire-Skaven battles the nearest standing enemy was 91 m or more in 90 %). rally_rate: points a second a routing unit regains while free, calibrated to the rallies of the whole battles (median 44 s). rout_floor_mp: where morale stands at most when the rout begins (recorded MoralePercent at the rout: median -0.03, 10 % below -0.17). rout_speed: a routing unit runs at this share of its run speed, before its innate effects. Measured 02.10.2026 (all fair recordings with unit keys, game-AI and network runs; speed over 1 s steps at least 3 s into a rout, moving): Empire units 0.865 of the run (median, 115k s), Skaven 0.945 below half health (186k s) and 0.866 above it (14k s): Scurry Away! (x1.1 while wavering or routing) and Strength in Numbers (x0.9 while health is above half) give 0.86 x 1.1 = 0.95 and 0.86 x 0.99 = 0.85. Running in order, not wavering, above half health: Empire 0.97, Skaven 0.88 (x0.91 = Strength in Numbers' x0.9). attacked_flank / attacked_rear: points while an enemy strikes from the flank / rear, instead of the database's was_attacked_in_flank -6 / _rear -14: regressing morale points - leadership of infantry in melee in the 28 whole battles (30k seconds; on health lost, flank, rear, contacts, the lf/rf/bf flags, under fire) gives -1.0 / -1.8, while the same regression on the simulator with the database's points gives -1 / -14.5. The same regression gives -3.9 / -8.1 for one / several of lf, rf, bf: the database's ume_concerned_flanks_exposed_single / _multiple -3 / -6, used as they are

fatigue.why: effects: the database's unit_fatigue_effects_tables (21 rows, read from db.pack 02.10.2026 by build/simacc/fat_db.py; level, stat, multiplier; missing x1): fatigue.py effects() scales speed, melee attack and defence, armour, charge bonus, AP damage and reload (time / stat_reloading). per_second: the database gives points per activity but not the time (a forum claim: a 0.1 s tick, 10x a second, not taken); regressing the recorded fatigue states (18 mirror battles, 1315 transitions) gives 5.0x a second for melee, 4.8x for shooting, 6.2x for running

threat.why: lf / rf / bf: a non-routing enemy within this distance in the left, right or rear sector; not calibrated

effects.off_why: off: effects the catalogue could model but the simulator leaves out (a calibration switch; each entry needs its reason here). Single Entity (the lords: speed x0.9, melee damage and AP x0.8 while health is below 25 %, by our reading of its recharge context health_below_25%; the knowledge base: WH3 single entities have a 'wounded' state at low health, thresholds not found): in the recordings (02.10.2026, all fair runs with unit keys) lords running out of melee move at 0.84-0.85 of their run in every health band (0.35-0.5, 0.25-0.35, 0.15-0.25, below 0.15; 4.9k-8.6k s each): no x0.9 below 25 %. On, it flipped two mirror battles whose replays split (5 of 8 and 4 of 8 before) and kept one more at 32 replays (same winner 20 of 26 against 21). Left out until a lord below 25 % health is recorded with the bridge's ActiveEffectList (units.md, recordings wanted). The network still sees it (owned; on by its condition).
effects.why: Innate effects (tools/nn/sim/effects.py, config/nn/effects.json from the game's database by python -m tools.nn.effects): every attribute and passive or game-fired ability of a unit, one mechanism; the catalogue's `modelled` effects are laid on. No numbers here: the stats, conditions and timers are the database's. Strength in Numbers and Scurry Away! were left out on 02.10.2026 when they alone made the pairs worse (50 of 54): then Strength in Numbers' +6 came on top of the fitted Skaven morale.faction_bonus +6 (the same thing counted twice) and Scurry Away! on top of one rout_speed fitted to both factions. With faction_bonus 0 and rout_speed refitted to the Empire (morale why) they are modelled as the database says.

abilities.why: Lord abilities (tools/nn/sim/abilities.py). The numbers (active and recharge time, range, targets, effects) are the ability passports, config/nn/abilities.json (py -3.14 -m tools.nn.abilities, the game's database); what each unit owns: units.json abilities (the slots: tools/nn/sim/abilities.py slot_keys). model: the cast abilities whose effects the simulator lays on (the lords' actives). Effects modelled: scalar_speed (walk, run, and the charge speed unless scalar_charge_speed is given), scalar_charge_speed, melee attack and defence (add), melee damage base and AP (mult), charge bonus (mult), stat_morale (add, morale points). Verminous Valour's 25 m, 1 s blast (battle_vortexs) has damage 0 and AP 0 (hand decode): not modelled. triggers: when the game's AI fires an active (an assumption, not measured): melee = its lord is in melee, near = a standing enemy within near_m of him (the recordings show the Warlord running 5-6.5 m/s, above his run 4.0 and charge 4.7, when closing in), waver = a friend within range_m wavers or routs; default_trigger for an active not listed. The network fires its lord's self-cast actives by order (Orders.ability). Passive and game-fired abilities (Hold the Line, Frenzy, Strength of the Penitent, Strength in Numbers, Scurry Away!, Single Entity) are innate effects since 02.10.2026 (`effects`): `model` lists only what this section lays on itself. Ready again recharge_s after the active time ends; ready at the start (no initial recharge found).
